task: 0.B2 (doc 02 §3.2, doc 13 §3); clean-room: runtime module listings only
counting_rule: One entry per module-capability registration printed by --list-verbose (the 502 header lines; every header carries at most one capability line). A single plugin binary can register several entries in different capabilities (avcodec: 5, lua: 8, stats: 6). 4 entries print without a capability line (base/parent modules: export, bridge, playlist, core) and are recorded as capability "(none)". Sum(by_capability.count) == total == 502, cross-checked 1:1 (name+description, in order) against the 502 module lines of dump 05. Every module object carries dump_line = line number of its header in dump 06.

seven_category_rollup.note: G3 rollup of card 0.B2 (doc 13 §3). Every registration lands in exactly one bucket. The seven categories are the minimum buckets; capabilities that do not fit are under "other" and mapped to Lumen plugin kinds or flagged in modules-summary.md §5.
